description: Undo a whole batch (give batch = the batch id from list_changes) or selected changes (change_ids). Safe by default: a field is put back only if it still has the value that change set; anything changed afterwards is left alone and listed as skipped (reason changed_since / gone / already_undone / not_allowed). Comments the batch added are deleted (for good). The undo is itself recorded, so it can be undone again. Returns { batch, reverted: [ids], skipped: [{ id, reason }] }.

batch.description: batch id from list_changes: undo the whole batch

change_ids.description: ids of single changes from list_changes, e.g. [101, 102]

name: undo_changes
